title: Studio
lede: Who I am when the dashboards are off — education, the current role, and the stack I keep sharp.

about.headline: I turn messy signals into decision-ready insight.
body: Whether that signal is a literal ECG waveform off a wearable patch, or a dataset that needs cleaning before anyone can trust a conclusion — the job is the same: clarity, reproducibility, and models that hold up outside the notebook.
I care about reports a stakeholder can act on, analysis another engineer can rerun, and datasets that do not lie by omission.
values: Clean datasets that enable reliable decisions
